project_type: Next.js 16 App Router + React 19 monorepo, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4
build_system: npm workspaces; Next.js App Router (app/ dir) + views/ pattern
test_framework: No unit tests for UI tour component; verification is tsc + build only
verification_instructions: 1. cd frontend-next  2. npm run lint  3. npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false  4. npm run build  All must pass with zero errors.
environment_constraints: Windows host (pwsh shell). Do NOT restart dev server. All edits are in frontend-next/. Run all commands from frontend-next/ directory. Never push to remote.
contribution_requirements: Per CONTRIBUTING.md: run lint + tsc + build before PR. Per frontend-next/AGENTS.md: read relevant Next.js docs before editing Next.js code.
key_patterns: data-page-guide attributes are plain HTML data attributes added to existing JSX elements. Exceptions: one <div data-page-guide='feed-posts'> wrapper in Home.tsx (AnimatePresence has no DOM parent) and a <div data-page-guide='orders-delivery-timeline'> wrapper around the DeliveryTimeline component. PageGuide.tsx uses 'use client', usePathname, useTranslation, createPortal. Copy object uses 'as const' tuples [title, body]. buildSteps() and getTourId() are pure functions before the component.
directory_structure: frontend-next/app/ = Next.js App Router pages; frontend-next/views/ = page-level React components; frontend-next/components/ = shared components; frontend-next/.agents/tasks/ = planning artifacts only (not committed)
